# Forecast strip (`forecast-strip`)

Horizontal strip of readings with within/outside states.

Group: Data display. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/data-display';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createForecastStrip` (types in `dist/web/data-display/forecastStrip.d.ts`): `.mh-forecast-strip` (`--days | --hours`): a `__list` (`role="list"`, named by `label`) of `__item`s (`.is-outside` mutes one). Each item has a visually hidden sentence for screen readers and, hidden from them, `__label`, a tinted `.mh-weather-icon`, `__value`, `__low` (days) and `__sub`. Days share the width in up to seven equal columns; hours scroll sideways with snap, no visible scrollbar, and the list is focusable for arrow-key scrolling.

```ts
export function createForecastStrip(options: ForecastStripOptions): ForecastStripHandle;

export interface ForecastStripOptions {
  /** Required: the list's accessible name ("Next 7 days"). */
  label: string;
  readings: readonly ForecastReading[];
  /** Appended to values (default "°"). */
  unit?: string;
  variant?: ForecastStripVariant;
  /** Spoken after `sub` ("rain" makes "80% rain"). */
  subName?: string;
}

export interface ForecastStripHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  update(options: ForecastStripOptions): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createForecastStrip, type ForecastReading } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const week: ForecastReading[] = [
  { label: 'Today', condition: 'partly-cloudy', value: 16, low: 9, sub: '10%' },
  { label: 'Thu', condition: 'rain', value: 14, low: 8, sub: '80%' },
  { label: 'Fri', condition: 'pouring', value: 12, low: 7, sub: '95%' },
  { label: 'Sat', condition: 'cloudy', value: 13, low: 6 },
  { label: 'Sun', condition: 'clear', value: 17, low: 7 },
];

const forecast = createForecastStrip({ label: 'Next 5 days', readings: week, subName: 'rain' });

// A newer forecast replaces the readings in place.
setTimeout(() => {
  const today: ForecastReading = { ...week[0]!, condition: 'rain', sub: '60%' };
  forecast.update({ label: 'Next 5 days', readings: [today, ...week.slice(1)], subName: 'rain' });
}, 5000);

document.body.append(forecast.el);
```
